## 779c7c31edc3

**Issue found: the easy curriculum removes the task's multi-object requirement.** Every canonical input contains two or three filled rectangles (component counts `3, 2, 3, 2, 3` across train/test), but the generator hard-pins `rectangles` to `1` whenever `difficulty="easy"`. A three-demo easy lesson therefore never demonstrates that the operation must be applied independently to every rectangle. The rival “hollow the sole/selected rectangle and leave any additional rectangles unchanged” is indistinguishable on all such generated lessons but fails the canonical examples.

There is a second profile gap in the same direction: generated rectangle heights are only `3..4`, while canonical inputs include `5×3` rectangles. The validator accepts them, but the default distribution never emits them.

Concrete repair direction: schedule at least one two- or three-rectangle scene in every lesson window, including easy, and include the observed canonical `5×3` size. No source was modified as part of this audit.
